_comment: NFR-18 — pinned pilot-site resource budgets. Every limit is a MAXIMUM; the check fails when the measured percentile exceeds the budget. Sources: single-tenant edge target hardware (4 vCPU, 4 GiB RAM, 64 GiB SSD) per docs/operations/component-and-portability.md §NFR-24.

_pins.referenceHardware: Ubuntu Server 24.04 LTS · 4 vCPU · 4 GiB RAM · 64 GiB SSD
_pins.updatePolicy: Changing any limit requires an ADR + a dated evidence run under docs/evaluation/evidence/ showing the new limit is tight enough.

diskGrowthBytesPerHour._note: Steady-state growth only — a backup/restore round-trip is expected to exceed this. Compute as total disk growth bytes / sample duration hours.
